void-navy.$description: Void Navy — Page background, hero canvas, section bands — the deep-space base on which all other UI floats

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

probe-cyan.$description: Probe Cyan — Hover/active accent variant for buttons and interactive states

hub-navy.$description: Hub Navy — Secondary surface tint, logo wordmark — a slightly lighter shade of the void used for depth

orbit-slate.$description: Orbit Slate — Card surfaces, inset panels, terminal block backgrounds — the next level up from the void

deck-charcoal.$description: Deck Charcoal — Elevated card surfaces, nested panel backgrounds — sits above Orbit Slate for layered depth

deep-hull.$description: Deep Hull — Borders on dark surfaces, section dividers within dark bands

steel-edge.$description: Steel Edge — Borders and dividers on cards and panels — the most common structural border

console-gray.$description: Console Gray — Secondary body text, muted labels, icon fills — readable on dark without competing with white headings

slate-mute.$description: Slate Mute — Helper text, captions, tertiary metadata — drops information below the primary read

mist.$description: Mist — De-emphasized text, disabled labels, low-priority inline content

halo.$description: Halo — Hairline borders on dark surfaces, subtle dividers, the dominant structural line color

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary text, filled button background, logo fills — maximum contrast against the void

status-green.$description: Status Green — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

inter.$description: Primary UI and heading typeface. Weight 300 for display headlines creates whisper-quiet authority; weight 400 for body; weight 500–600 for nav, buttons, and labels.

jetbrains-mono.$description: Code blocks, terminal output, CLI commands like `npx checkly init`. The custom font signal 'this is executable'.

ui-monospace.$description: System monospace fallback for inline code, tab indicators, secondary code contexts

consolas.$description: Consolas — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
